message.content:
I don’t have access to live clock data, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the current time in New York City, you can:

1. **Check your phone or computer’s world clock** – most devices let you add New York (Eastern Time) as a separate time zone.  
2. **Use an online world clock** – sites like timeanddate.com or the built‑in “World Clock” feature on many browsers will show the current time in New York.  
3. **Ask a smart assistant** – say “What time is it in New York?” to Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, etc.

If you’d like, I can also tell you the sunrise and sunset times for New York City on a specific date. Just let me know the date you’re interested in!
